Name: Iconic Framework
Author: LeFauxMatt
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ulr2XSt.png[/img]
This mod is a Framework for adding shortcut icons that can be used instead of hotkeys or commands. Iconic Framework can be added directly from other mods, or they can be added outside the mod using a content pack for Content Patcher.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oszWv38.png[/img]
Toolbar Icons is safe to add/remove at any time.

Currently supported mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2733]Always Scroll Map[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9791]Better Chests[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url]﻿

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1691]Data Layers[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679]Debug Mode﻿[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/search/]Easy Access[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]Event Lookup[/url]﻿

Additionally, the mod has build-in access to certain vanilla features:
[list]
[*]Calendar
[*]Daily Quests
[*]Special Orders
[*]Toggling Collisions (NoClip)
[/list]
Mod authors can add their own icons by using the [url=https://github.com/LeFauxMatt/FauxCore/blob/develop/FauxCommon/Integrations/IconicFramework/IIconicFrameworkApi.cs]Iconic Framework Api[/url]﻿. Are there any other mods that have added support which I have missed? Please let me know in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11026/?tab=forum&topic_id=13869371]Feedback & Suggestions [/url]forum.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lG4kcA2.png[/img]
For ease of use, it is recommended to set config options from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fMhu2q8.png[/img]
